build_FastRCNNLossComputation: build a FastRCNNLossComputation instance with a Matcher, BalancedPositiveNegativeSampler, and BoxCoder for Faster R-CNN loss
run_subsample_proposals: run subsample on proposals and targets to perform positive/negative sampling for ROI box head training
compute_classification_and_box_loss: compute classification loss via cross entropy and box regression loss via smooth L1 for Faster R-CNN
match_targets_to_proposals: match ground truth targets to proposals using IoU and a Matcher to get matched indices
create_roi_box_loss_evaluator: create an ROI box loss evaluator from a config with Matcher, BoxCoder, and sampler settings
